cues: WKRS marine weather for HollowVale Harbor and the waters off Gull Point.
Tonight: fog over the harbor, low near forty. Visibility under one hundred feet.
Small craft should stay tied up. All craft should stay tied up.
Winds calm. Seas calm. Too calm.
Tides: high tide at three twelve. Low tide at three twelve.
The lighthouse on Gull Point remains dark. Mariners are advised not to follow any light they see in the fog.
Keep your lantern lit. Keep the radio on. And keep your window shut.
This has been the WKRS marine weather. The next forecast will be the same.
